integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard canonical/terminal region and quotient description; exact enumeration independently replays the formulas through r=200. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the two-heavy weighted-projective family. The theorem determines the generic stabilizer order distribution along the heavy-coordinate line, not every local analytic type. The finite checker is a regression test rather than the proof.
title: Exact stabilizer-order distribution in two-heavy canonical and terminal weighted projective spaces
